definitions.gloss: fed up, sick and tired, disgusted
definitions.explanation: Feeling weary or annoyed from too much of something.

examples.japanese: うんざり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦{待|ま}たされた→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I was made to wait until I was fed up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧うんざり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm fed up with the same work every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{渋滞|じゅうたい}→渋滞：03279_juutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧うんざり⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I got fed up with traffic jams and decided to commute by train.

notes:
うんざり expresses being fed up, sick and tired, or disgusted—typically from too much of something or repetition.

USAGE:
- うんざり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be/become fed up
- うんざりだ: (I'm) fed up (direct statement)
- うんざり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧: to the point of being fed up

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧/⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ うんざり⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be fed up with ~
- ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧うんざり: fed up with the same thing every day
- ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧うんざり: sick of excuses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- うんざり: fed up (stronger negative feeling)
- ⟦{飽|あ}きる→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧: to get tired of (more neutral)
- ⟦げんなり→げんなり：04830_gennari⟧: weary, dispirited (similar but softer)
